verdict: Startup is blocked by synchronous main-thread initialization.
executive_summary: Move the launch-critical lookup after the first frame, then repeat the same cold-start scenario.

conclusions.problem: 启动首屏显示明显偏慢。
conclusions.cause: SmartPerfetto 证据显示主线程的同步 Binder 等待与启动关键区间重叠。
conclusions.source_root_cause: 源码中的启动方法同步读取设置，阻塞了首帧之前的主线程。
conclusions.recommendation: 把设置读取延迟到首帧之后，并按相同冷启动场景复测。

top_findings.user_impact: The first screen appears later than the existing target.

recommendations.title: Defer the synchronous lookup
recommendations.action: Move the lookup after the first frame.
recommendations.expected_effect: Remove the identified Binder wait from the launch-critical path.

recommendations.title: Repeat the startup capture
recommendations.action: Collect the same cold-start recipe after the change.
recommendations.expected_effect: Confirm the existing startup metric against its threshold.

source_fixes.diagnosis: The matched startup method performs a synchronous settings lookup.

source_fixes.retest_target: Repeat the cold-start scenario and compare the existing display metric.

retest_plan.steps: Capture five cold starts with the same recipe.
